correctness.rationale: Stationary leftmost-window minima are nondecreasing; newly selected positions correspond exactly to changed minima between adjacent windows. The full 24-order certificate checks coefficient positivity after u=p/(1−2p) for all 2≤w≤8 and for all but two orders at w=9; the exceptional second is strictly above B. The A−B difference is p²(p−1)H(p), and a two-sign-change Descartes transform plus exact rational sign intervals proves precisely two simple roots. Two independent standard-library implementations executed successfully. There are no unproved extrapolations past the stated w range.

value.rationale: The theorem resolves a natural source-adaptive minimizer design invariant for a continuum of Bernoulli parameters, exhibiting a genuinely nonmonotone double switch in global best strict ranking first at the ninth window. A commonly used frequency-prioritization heuristic need not minimize actual sampling density. The exact switching intervals and uniqueness structure supply a motivated small-alphabet benchmark and counterexample; novelty is not based on arbitrary cutoffs or a claimed practical speedup.
